{{Quote|One extremely intoxicated enlisted trooper attempted to eat 50 Spiced Mynock Wings from the buffet. The mess he made of the dropship interior has kept it out of commission for several days. No one can stand the smell!|Official reprimand from Eastern Arch Platoon Leader Ton E'rau|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="SQ" /> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''enlisted trooper''' was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. At one point during said [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] became intoxicated and attempted to devour fifty [[Spiced Mynock Wing]]s. As a result, a [[Unidentified dropship|dropship]] was put out of commission for several days due to the smell caused by the mess he made. [[Eastern Arch Platoon]] Leader [[Ton E'rau]] used the intoxicated stormtrooper as an example in an official reprimand to the stormtrooper's leader, [[TK-934]]. E'rau warned TK-934 that if the many illegal actions, such as the intoxicated stormtrooper's behavior, were not stopped, TK-934 would suffer a demotion.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The intoxicated stormtrooper was first mentioned in "The [[Infinite Nebstar Casino]]" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', a [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2010]].
